title: Dependencies
description: data/dependencies.json -- the graph of the project's objects and of what each reads, written at every export (spec docs/requirements/completed/2026-10-21-graphe-dependances.md, issue #71; calc/domains/dependency_graph.py, docs/domain/dependencies.md). Read by the «Dépendances» tab and by the next export, which says what changed since; Typst never reads it. A function of the sources alone: the same bytes when nothing changed.

schema_version.description: -- pinned: a graph written at another version is not compared, the export then saying nothing changed (CON-002).

digest.description: The SHA-256 of the object's record without its presentation keys (dependency_graph.PRESENTATION): what tells the next export it changed. None on a section, a profile, a document.

file.description: The object's source, from the project's folder: what the tab opens and compares with the export's time.

enabled.description: A section: whether its document prints it.

unresolved.description: A section: how many of its calls name an object Woodcore cannot place -- a document's own registry, a domain it does not know.

edges.description: `from` reads `to` through `field`: sorted, each once. `to` `<kind>:*` is every object of that kind (a section's loop, a list of them).

field.description: The field or the command it is read through: `position`, `members[0].position`, `/links/N`, `show-calc`.

variable.description: The variable read, `<domain>/<instance>/<var>`, where it is one.

previous.description: Read in the last export rather than in this one: a script's value() of a connector or a polar moment.

line.description: A section: the line of the call.
